newsitem.title: USA: US Senate panel approves Cuomo as HUD secretary.
newsitem.headline: US Senate panel approves Cuomo as HUD secretary.

text.p: The U.S. Senate Banking Committee Tuesday unanimously approved Andrew Cuomo's nomination to be secretary of Housing and Urban Development, voting 17-0.
Committee Chairman Alfonse D'Amato, (R-New York), said he would try to have the full Senate confirm Cuomo by Thursday.
Cuomo, an assistant HUD secretary and the son of former New York governor Mario Cuomo, will replace Henry Cisneros.
